example:
import { EditorialPanel, ResponsiveGrid } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<ResponsiveGrid preset="panels">
  <EditorialPanel tag="NEXT" title="More ways to discover." items={["Products and their contents"]} />
</ResponsiveGrid>
name: EditorialPanel
tagline: A bordered panel with a short tag, a heading and a list (gh#1440) — a roadmap group. Lay a row of them out with `ResponsiveGrid preset="panels"` (tracks and gap are `--responsive-grid-panels-*`, re-declared at the theme's own steps). Geometry: `--editorial-panel-*`.
usage: DO lay a row of panels out with `ResponsiveGrid preset="panels"`.
